name: The Age Of The Earth
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that God created the heavens and the earth at the beginning of time, accomplishing this work in six days and resting on the seventh, as affirmed in Genesis 1:1 and Exodus 20:11. The creation was intentional and authoritative, with the worlds being framed by God's word, not formed from preexisting materials (Hebrews 11:3). The timeline of human history begins with God's creation of man in His likeness (Genesis 5:1), and the subsequent genealogies and events, such as the 430 years of Israel's sojourning in Egypt (Exodus 12:40), provide a framework for understanding the earth's age within a biblical context.
